papers.reason: short conference abstract on GenAI in studio-based design education; describes impacts (disrupted critiques, diffused ethical responsibility) and proposes reframing pedagogy around process transparency, but enumerates no categories or dimensions

proposes a six-stage governance strategy (the SMART-G Framework) and applies existing NIST AI RMF, RACI, and ISO/IEC 42001 frameworks to deepfake response, but these are process/governance stages and roles for handling deepfakes, not an enumerable scheme describing a disclosure, attribution, or provenance claim about produced content
